# Composed project covers

Four coordinated 1536 × 1024 covers for the Turtle-inspired alternate homepage.
Generated with the built-in Image Generation tool from existing project screenshots,
then encoded as WebP at quality 90. The original source screens remain in their
project folders and case studies. These are presentation mockups; generated small
text, icons, and chart details can vary slightly from the original UI.

| Cover                     | Composition                                                           | Source screens                                                                  | Exact prompt                     |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| [Numi](numi-cover.webp)   | Layered phones, plum and amber lighting                               | `../numi/device-home.webp`, `device-meal.webp`, `device-progress.webp`          | [Prompt](numi-cover-prompt.txt)  |
| [Tysha](tysha-cover.webp) | Three phones, copper and sand setting                                 | `../tysha/screen-1.webp`, `screen-2.webp`, `screen-3.webp`                      | [Prompt](tysha-cover-prompt.txt) |
| [Karta](karta-cover.webp) | Desktop dashboard behind three mobile screens, blue and teal backdrop | `../karta/dashboard@2x.jpg`, `guest-menu.jpg`, `guest-dish.jpg`, `guest-ai.jpg` | [Prompt](karta-cover-prompt.txt) |
| [Linc](linc-cover.webp)   | Overlapping desktop windows, cobalt and lavender backdrop             | `../linc/linc-2@2x.jpg`, `linc-3@2x.jpg`                                        | [Prompt](linc-cover-prompt.txt)  |

The user's Turtle screenshot (`Screenshot 2026-09-14 at 22.01.21.png`) was used only
as a composition reference. No Turtle product screen, branding, cursor,
or application overlay is included in the covers. The circular hover labels are
live HTML/CSS overlays, separate from these assets.
